difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the condition that a module be flat over the base at all primes containing the image of an ideal is preserved under a base change of the base ring and an extension of the ideal. The proof takes a prime of the base changed algebra containing the extended ideal and the image of the ideal, notes that the corresponding prime of the algebra before base change contains both ideals so that flatness holds there by hypothesis, observes that the localisation at the prime of the base change is a localisation of the base change of the flat localised module, and concludes flatness of that localisation from stability of flatness under base change and under localisation.
